as_told.title: Condon report and AARO still leave over 30% unidentified

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the 1968 Condon report, the final report of a university UFO study, led to the closing of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and brushed off its cases with ordinary explanations. Michels says that if you read the report itself, over 30 percent of the cases stayed unidentified, which he links to Blue Book's scientific adviser J. Allen Hynek. He tells it to show that the dismissive conclusion did not match the report's own contents.
